rules.name: Accurate x
rules.text: Retain x of your attack dice as normal successes without rolling them. Accurate stacks up to a maximum of 2.

rules.name: Balanced
rules.text: You can re-roll one of your attack dice.

rules.name: Blast x
rules.text: After resolving the attack against the primary target, resolve it against every other operative visible to and within x of that target, using the same cover and obscured state.

rules.name: Brutal
rules.text: Your opponent can only block your successes with critical successes.

rules.name: Ceaseless
rules.text: You can re-roll any of your attack dice that share the same result.

rules.name: Devastating x
rules.text: Each critical success immediately inflicts x damage on the target, before any other attack dice are resolved.

rules.name: Heavy (x)
rules.text: This weapon cannot be used if the operative has already moved this activation, and the operative cannot move after using it — except for the move type named in brackets.

rules.name: Hot
rules.text: Before the attack, roll a D6. If the result is less than the weapon's Hit stat, the operative suffers damage equal to twice the roll.

rules.name: Lethal x+
rules.text: This weapon scores critical successes on x+ instead of 6+.

rules.name: Limited x
rules.text: This weapon can only be used x times per battle.

rules.name: Piercing Crits x
rules.text: If you retain any critical successes, the defender rolls x fewer defence dice.

rules.name: Piercing x
rules.text: The defender rolls x fewer defence dice.

rules.name: Punishing
rules.text: If you retain any critical successes, retain one of your failed dice as a normal success.

rules.name: Range x
rules.text: Only operatives within x of the attacker are valid targets for this weapon.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.text: You can re-roll any or all of your attack dice.

rules.name: Rending
rules.text: If you retain any critical successes, you can retain one of your normal successes as a critical success instead.

rules.name: Saturate
rules.text: The defender cannot retain cover saves against this weapon.

rules.name: Seek x
rules.text: Ignore terrain of the named type when checking visibility and obscuring — the target is treated as visible. It can still retain a cover save.

rules.name: Severe
rules.text: If you do not retain any critical successes, you can change one of your normal successes into a critical success. No effect alongside Punishing or Rending.

rules.name: Shock
rules.text: The first critical success you resolve in each sequence also discards one of the target's unresolved normal successes (or a critical success if it has none).

rules.name: Silent
rules.text: This weapon can be used to shoot while the operative is in Conceal order.

rules.name: Stun
rules.text: Each critical success reduces the target's APL by 1 until the end of its next activation.

rules.name: Torrent x
rules.text: Select a primary target, then select any other valid targets within x of it, and resolve the attack against each of them.
